idea-plugin.name: JSON Canopy
idea-plugin.description:
JSON Canopy opens .json files as nested, filterable, editable tables instead of raw text, in an extra tab next to the built-in JSON editor.

Explore

  • Objects and arrays render as tables inside tables. An array of objects becomes one column per item, so you can compare entries at a glance.
  • Flip a table between horizontal and vertical orientation, and hide columns with the field selector.
  • Large arrays are paged, so big files stay responsive. Load more items when you need them.

Search

  • Four filter modes: match anywhere, keys only, the containing object, or the surrounding context. Context mode keeps the matching item together with the structure around it.

Edit in place

  • Change any value directly, with a type dropdown per value (string, number, boolean, null, object, array).
  • Add or remove object keys and array items with + and ×.
  • Edits go through the IDE, so undo and redo work.
  • Prefer text? Edit the whole document as raw JSON, or copy and download the result.

Fits your IDE

  • Light and dark themes follow the IDE theme automatically.
  • It is an additional tab. Schema validation and completion stay on the standard JSON tab, so this is a specialized view, not a replacement.

Source code and issues: github.com/OldPeasant/json-canopy
